content: When a patient's blood glucose levels are 5% or more above their target, combination therapy is frequently necessary to achieve glycemic control. This approach involves the use of agents with high efficacy, such as GLP-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs), dual GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonists (GIP/GLP-1 RAs), and SGLT2 inhibitors. These pharmacological agents, when used in combination, offer a comprehensive treatment strategy by addressing both glycemic regulation and cardiovascular health simultaneously.
